g.desc: TellMeLight Rev A KiCad schematic baseline

g.text: USB-C J1: VBUS enters protected 5V rail; CC1/CC2 use 5.1k Rd pull-downs.

g.desc: USB-C J1: VBUS enters protected 5V rail; CC1/CC2 use 5.1k Rd pull-downs.

g.text: USB data: J1 D+/D- -> TPD2EUSB30 U5 -> 27R series resistors -> RP2040 U1 USB pins.

g.desc: USB data: J1 D+/D- -> TPD2EUSB30 U5 -> 27R series resistors -> RP2040 U1 USB pins.

g.text: Power: VBUS -> AP2112K-3.3 U4 -> 3V3 for RP2040, flash, and LP5024 logic.

g.desc: Power: VBUS -> AP2112K-3.3 U4 -> 3V3 for RP2040, flash, and LP5024 logic.

g.text: MCU: RP2040 U1 uses W25Q32JVSS U3 QSPI flash, 12 MHz Y1, SWD1, BOOT SW1, RESET SW2.

g.desc: MCU: RP2040 U1 uses W25Q32JVSS U3 QSPI flash, 12 MHz Y1, SWD1, BOOT SW1, RESET SW2.

g.text: LED driver: RP2040 I2C0 SDA/SCL -> LP5024 U2 with 4.7k pull-ups to 3V3.

g.desc: LED driver: RP2040 I2C0 SDA/SCL -> LP5024 U2 with 4.7k pull-ups to 3V3.

g.text: Light zones: LP5024 OUT0..OUT17 sink six common-anode RGB LEDs D1..D6 from VLED.

g.desc: Light zones: LP5024 OUT0..OUT17 sink six common-anode RGB LEDs D1..D6 from VLED.

g.text: Reserved: LP5024 OUT18..OUT23 are kept for Rev B brightness or status expansion.

g.desc: Reserved: LP5024 OUT18..OUT23 are kept for Rev B brightness or status expansion.
